thread.title: Nasdaq 100 Movers: IDXX, AAPL

author: BNK Invest
title: Nasdaq 100 Movers: IDXX, AAPL
text:
Shutterstock photo In early trading on Wednesday, shares of Apple ( AAPL ) topped the list of the day's best performing components of the Nasdaq 100 index, trading up 4.4%. Year to date, Apple registers a 17.4% gain.
And the worst performing Nasdaq 100 component thus far on the day is Idexx Laboratories ( IDXX ), trading down 5.9%. Idexx Laboratories is showing a gain of 47.4% looking at the year to date performance.
Two other components making moves today are Baidu ( BIDU ), trading down 4.9%, and Take-Two Interactive Software ( TTWO ), trading up 2.5% on the day.
